The other side is Hat Yai, a trade and food hub that buzzes day and night, with night markets, malls, and a steady stream of visitors from Malaysia and Singapore. Songkhla eats well across the board: fresh seafood, bold southern dishes, Hat Yai-style dim sum for breakfast, and local sweets like tao kuan. People come to Songkhla to stroll the old town, eat seafood, and hit Hat Yai all in one trip.

The other side of Suphan Buri is luk thung country, the birthplace of several famous singers, with a memorial and museum that tell that story specifically. Outside town you'll find wide rice fields broken up by old temples and a buffalo village. If you'd rather travel without much planning, come to Suphan Buri and tick off the spots one by one — it works well for a family trip or a self-drive weekend.

The other side of the province borders the Khao Yai range, with the Prachinburi side of Khao Yai National Park, forest waterfalls, and the Hin Phoeng rapids, a popular rainy-season rafting spot. Famous local eats include boat noodles, and Prachin santol, a fruit with large fruits and sweet flesh.

The top-tier luxury name in the area, on Ratchadamri Road near the Ratchaprasong intersection and the Erawan Shrine. Rooms are finished with marble and custom artwork, and there's the Peacock Alley lounge, a multi-floor spa, and restaurants like Bull & Bear. Reviews praise the beautiful rooms, the high level of service, and the pool, though some find it pricey with extra surcharges. Best reserved for a genuine special occasion.

The top-tier luxury name in the area, set within the Central Embassy mall on Wireless Road, with an easy connection into the mall and to Phloen Chit BTS. Rooms are plush and modern, and there's an outdoor pool, a spa, and several restaurants plus a high-floor lounge. It has held two Michelin Keys for two years running. Reviews praise the location, service, and cleanliness, though some feel the in-hotel dining options are still limited. Best for travellers who want the most upscale stay attached to the area's luxury mall.
